description: This is a React functional component implementing a Dashboard page for a career development application. It displays KPIs, competency gaps, recent evidence, and quick actions. It fetches data from various APIs and displays it with interactive elements.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Async function that loads all necessary data for the dashboard, including user auth, profile info, gap analysis, evidence, and KPIs.

methods.name: deriveTraffic
methods.description: Helper function that determines traffic light status ('Green', 'Amber', 'Red') based on profile level and role target.

methods.name: onRefreshKpis
methods.description: Handler to refresh KPI data and gap analysis, updating the component state accordingly.

methods.name: onExportPdf
methods.description: Handler to generate and download a PDF export of the profile.
